selector_array.interpretation: record ID indexed by a selector byte; semantic meaning of each ID remains unknown

selector_26_overread.status: does not match the 25 canonical $0800 streams; whether the bank-22 NMI callback is invoked for this selector remains unresolved

selector_26_alternate_upload.interpretation: Strong static pairing from the shared $6467 selector; exact runtime callback timing and residency have not been captured

nmi_gate.condition: callback requested when zero; nonzero skips the callback

selector_6409_write_examples.operation: select a $60C8,X list entry into $6409 in the list-selection loop
initialize $6409 to $FF before rebuilding a unit-slot list

observed_operations: read $6408 into Y as the comparison slot
scan the paired $64B7/$648F fields and accept entries one step away on one field while matching the other field
append qualifying slot indices to $60C8 starting at $60C8[0]
when multiple entries exist, compare $65A8:$65A7 as a little-endian 16-bit value and select the entry with the smallest value
list_selector.interpretation: $6409 is selected from slots adjacent to the $6408 slot in the paired $64B7/$648F fields; treating those fields as grid coordinates is a strong but unverified interpretation

record_fields.$648F: first of two consecutive bytes loaded through ($1E),Y in bank 8 at $806B
record_fields.$64B7: second of two consecutive bytes loaded through ($1E),Y in bank 8 at $8070

relative_position_loader.interpretation: $6557/$6558 are record-derived bounds or base values; $65A7/$65A8 hold their mutable offset-relative position pair

record_group_lookup.interpretation: checks which counted ID list contains the record index; the game meanings of the groups are unknown

operations: load $64B7,X, shift left three times, store at $0616
load $648F,X, subtract $6802, shift left four times, store at $0618
bank 2 $88A0-$88D8 adds $0616/$0618 to $65A7/$65A8 pairs and checks the result against $6557/$6558
position_calculation.interpretation: per-slot character or unit positions are strongly indicated by the loader, bounded updates, adjacency search, and shared selector slots; axis orientation and units remain unknown, and the distinct scaling factors do not establish equivalent tile coordinates

evidence: bank 2 $8200 increments it and $827A decrements it during the movement loop
baseline_state.interpretation: mutable position or offset state is indicated; camera origin, cursor position, and animation-counter roles remain unresolved

conclusion: OAM and indexed PPU data both resolve through $6467, but they use independent selectors $6408 and $6409. Static code sometimes synchronizes them and sometimes assigns $6409 separately or uses $FF. Runtime record-to-stream pairing is not yet confirmed.
limitations: Static ROM evidence only; selector values and mapper mapping have not been captured during a battle frame.
The meanings of $60C8, $6408, $6409, and the records in $6467 are not fully decoded.
